suite.name: CB Suite
suite.notes: Lists the new Equipment Sales - Aspire app, so you can install it from here. In a selling season, the home page shows how many machines on its sell list to put up now; click it to open the app.

dashboard.name: CB Dashboard
dashboard.notes: A new For Sale page for the shop TV: the machines listed in Equipment Sales - Aspire, with photo, price, meter and condition, so crews get first look. Give a screen the page in Settings → Displays. Shop Status leaves out requests tagged to sell a machine.

requests.name: Equipment Requests - Aspire
requests.notes: Requests tagged to sell a machine ("Retire / Sell") no longer show as repair work. They go to the sell list in Equipment Sales - Aspire instead.

photos.name: Property Photos - Aspire
photos.notes: Settings gear at the bottom left: update this app on its own, without CB Suite, and choose whether it checks for updates each time it opens and asks before updating. Follows the theme CB Suite assigns it (Daylight Glass, Field Notes or Night Shift).

reference.name: Reference - Aspire
reference.notes: A small release to test updating from inside the app (Settings → Updates, or the pop-up when it opens). Nothing else has changed.

sales.name: Equipment Sales - Aspire
sales.notes: The first release. A sell list of every machine ranked by age, meter and a year of repairs, with crew flags from Aspire Mobile on top; a page per sale with the listing text, photos, where it's listed, offers, the checklist and a bill of sale; and a public for-sale page. Reads Aspire only.
